headline: Anthropic and Amazon announce a $100 billion AWS commitment and up to 5 GW of compute
summary: On April 20, 2026, Anthropic and Amazon announced an expanded compute collaboration. Anthropic said it committed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS technologies over ten years and would secure up to 5 GW of current and future Trainium capacity for Claude. The companies also announced $5 billion of Amazon investment, with up to another $20 billion tied to commercial milestones, and wider Claude availability through AWS. Both announcements describe a forward-looking agreement; the reviewed sources do not establish full contract terms, actual spending, delivered capacity or whether the commitment is exclusive.
